race.description: Retired Jockeys & Trainers Reunion Today Mdn Hcp
race.comment: QUIQUE (2) did a fair job on debut last time out finishing second over 1000m at Casino. Can open winning account this time. COSMIC FUN (8) was in the money two starts back at this track but couldn't back it up last time when twelfth over 1400m at Coffs Harbour. Finds a nice race and can get the job done. STAR OF WINSTON (1) finished out of the money two starts back then he was never in contention when ninth over 1000m at Coffs Harbour three weeks ago. Ideally placed and is sure to prove tough to beat. GOSLING (4) didn't do a lot on debut a month ago, finishing seventh over 975m at Swan Hill. Plenty of scope for improvement. Can improve.
